amendment_scope: 1. final_verdict: PASS — Phase 11.1-Z.1 amendment sealed. Three REAL ELF DSOs (core libxml2.so.16 + libxslt.so.1 + libexslt.so.0 facades) with correct SONAMEs and the upstream NEEDED chain, verified by the DSO-LOADER (40/40) and INSTALL-LAYOUT (73/73) courts and by consumer link/run for every -l flow; full-surface symbol-type scan 0 mismatches (R-000174) and C14N entity-ref parity restored (R-000175); R-000157 reclassified UNRESOLVED (real executed-platform gap, implementation work item); generated-evidence identity binds the Doxygen inventories (38) and headers; parity matrix per-project DSO accounting fixed; verification ladder corrected; PREPROCESSOR-SURFACE/AST-SURFACE courts real; 79 residuals (77 FIXED / 2 OPEN); 1178 tests; evidence reproducible.
